Description.Title: Thapa 2024 Model 4 senescent mesothelial clearance
Description.Details: Cell-resolved translation of Thapa et al., Cellular and Molecular Life Sciences (2024), DOI 10.1007/s00018-023-05017-x, Model 4. CC3D source: https://github.com/vivanbharat/MS-Thesis-code. Paper Figure 4, S12, S13, Table S2 and methods pages 4,7,13. One MCS = 18/750 = 0.024 hours; 120 hours = 5000 MCS. Lattice spacing is in source pixels; a physical micrometre conversion was not reported. Source initial checkerboard only: counts 25 SEN, 16 NON_SEN, 8 CANCER; frozen one-pixel WALL. Random cell areas and elasticities, stochastic pressure-limited growth, size-triggered random mitosis, and background death follow author code. SEN do not divide. Cancer-contact extrusion uses a strict fraction > 0.55 as in S13, independent of global confluence. It sets target area to zero and elasticity to 10000, then removes the remnant. No chemotaxis: source secretion and chemotactic response are disabled. Directed motility is isotropic at initialization; source PixelBased external-potential energy maps to source-to-target copy direction. One-MCS velocity approximates the source's last successful pixel-copy displacement in its alpha=0.5 update every 50 MCS. Morpheus compat-cc3d surface scaling and fourth-order contacts preserve raw J values and first-order perimeters. ConnectivityConstraint is an explicit Morpheus regularizer. The single population CSV records exactly 100 requested times including both endpoints; integer counts are explicit cell entities, with separate area and contact observables. Full per-cell states are also saved as TIFF for audit.

Event.name: SEN cancer-contact extrusion
Event.Condition: extrusion_enabled == 1 and Vt > 0 and cancer_fraction > perimeter_threshold
